app.name: KinesiApp
app.description: Video analysis of jumps and squats to detect knee injury risk.
app.disclaimer: KinesiApp is a support tool and does not replace an assessment by a health professional.

landing.title: Spot injury risk before it shows up
landing.lead: Record a jump or a squat and get an estimate of your knee injury risk based on the joint angles of the movement.

features.title: Athletes
features.body: Record your movements and follow how your risk evolves.

features.title: Coaches
features.body: Manage your team and review each athlete's analyses.

features.title: On any device
features.body: Works in the browser on your phone and your computer.

points: Your coach, up to date with your progress

capture.subtitle: Upload a video of your jump or squat to analyze the injury risk.

capture.limitHint: A single video, up to {max} MB.

guide.title: For a reliable analysis
items: Record at 30 fps and upload the original file, without forwarding it through WhatsApp or other apps that compress it.
No mirrors or other people in the background.
Feet inside the frame for the whole movement, including the landing.
A steady camera, to the side or at three quarters of the athlete.

errors.videoInvalidType: The selected file isn't a video.

consent.title: Video consent
paragraphs: The video is analyzed automatically to estimate the joint angles and the movement technique.
It's stored with its analysis and deleted when the recording is deleted. It isn't a medical diagnosis.
consent.checkbox: I have read and agree to this video processing.
